title: Generational GC in ART
key_conclusions: Generational GC should be explained through ART space, collector, barrier, and runtime evidence rather than by directly importing HotSpot Eden/Survivor/Old terminology.

The main benefit depends on the young-object mortality hypothesis; when young collections free many short-lived objects, the engineering fix is usually allocation-rate reduction rather than collector tuning.
A low-freed young or partial GC should move the investigation to retained paths, Large Object Space pressure, or Native/Graphics memory instead of blaming generational GC.
Target Android branch validation is mandatory because collector names, log fields, and default generational behavior differ across ART versions and ROMs.
shallow_points: The article still uses command templates and does not decode a real device GC log line with concrete young/full fields.
It does not validate exact generational collector defaults against a specific Android branch checkout.
It does not include a real Perfetto trace proving young collection pause and total-time behavior on a target device.
discovered_connections: Day 13 pause analysis feeds directly into generational GC because young collection benefits must be verified with paused, total time, Perfetto scheduling, and frame overlap.
Day 12 trigger timing remains necessary because frequent young GC is often a For Alloc and allocation-churn signal.
Day 10 retained-path analysis remains the fallback when young or partial GC frees little memory.
Day 3 allocation-path and LOS concepts explain why large objects may bypass the expected young-object fast-reclaim story.
suggest_future_topics: A later article should decode a real Android GC log line field by field and distinguish young, partial, full, For Alloc, Background, and Explicit signals.
Profiler and MAT articles should reuse the young-GC decision flow and add concrete allocation-rate and retained-path screenshots or sample tables.
Bitmap and large-object articles should reuse the LOS boundary from this article to avoid over-attributing memory pressure to Java generational GC.
knowledge_gaps: Need target-branch validation for exact ART generational collector names, defaults, and source call paths.
Need a real Perfetto capture that shows young collection, full collection fallback, GC thread scheduling, and frame overlap.
Need ROM/version comparison for GC log fields that expose or hide young-generation behavior.
